features: Perform beyond your imagination. With maximum read speeds of 205MB/s, you can transfer your data extremely quickly. Maximum write speeds of 150MB/s allow you to capture burst photos without missing a single photo. Lexar Silver Plus Micro SD Card guarantees better application performance and faster charging with A2 performance standard.

Video recording as detailed as you. Rated V30 and U3, Lexar Silver Plus UHS-I Micro SD Card is designed to capture burst photos without missing a photo and smoothly shoots ultra HD videos up to 4K 60fps.
Extensive compatibility. Tested to ensure compatibility with most smartphones and tablets, drones and action cameras, such as DJI, GoPro, Switch, SteamDeck, and more.

Hard enough. Built to last, Lexar Micro SD memory card is resistant to temperatures, X-rays, vibrations, magnetisms, shocks and drops so you can take it with confidence wherever your shooting takes you.

Peace of mind included. This micro SD card comes with Lexar Recovery Tool, a lifetime data recovery software to help you recover accidentally deleted files and is backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
